integrity: Exact algebraic proof and independent finite-field enumerations over 3, 9, and 27 elements; no claim of external independent audit or machine formalization.
scientific_limitations: Counts are for smooth normalized coefficient triples of a three-parameter Ciani plane quartic family in characteristic three, not for distinct geometric isomorphism classes or arithmetic twists; proofs rely on standard elliptic quotient and Ciani smoothness arguments and the displayed global character-sum identity. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Complete finite-field \(3\)-rank distribution in the characteristic-three Ciani family
